svg.title: Software Factory All-in-One — method preview
svg.desc: Animated forge-atelier preview: requirements intake lights the rails, a day line stamps Build through Ship, then the coverage ratchet climbs. Forever generic — no product names.

g.text: Drop one requirements file — the factory detects it and opens the line.
detected · actor loop armed · no MVP mode
plan · prototype · judgment · day rails · CI gates
· forever generic · practices only · public MIT mirror
Must-finish → evidence → PR → green CI → merge → Done. No theater.
Author ≠ judge · skip CD honestly when hooks are missing · never invent Done
Every useful lesson lands in the kit — then the public mirror stays in sync.
synced · MIT · ready for the next product
